description: Switches allow the user to toggle an option on or off.
title: Default

description: Use the checked attribute to activate the switch.
title: Checked

description: The focus event gives the user feedback that the Switch has been focused by the keyboard interaction.
title: Focus

description: Use disabled only when changing the setting is unavailable, and explain what prevents toggling it. Use readonly to show an existing on/off state without allowing changes.
title: Disabled

description: Use readonly to display an existing on/off setting that users may inspect but cannot toggle here. Use disabled only when the setting is unavailable.
title: Readonly

description: Use the size attribute to change a switch’s size.
title: Sizes

description: Add descriptive help text to a switch with the help-text attribute. For help texts that contain HTML, use the help-text slot instead.The help-text attribute should not be used to display error messages. To handle validation and error messaging, use syn-validate for proper error management.
title: Help Text

description: The invalid status is used to warn the user that the Switch is invalid.
title: Invalid
